basic_details.job_title: OHRC Internship Programme Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Odisha Human Rights Commission (OHRC) has invited applications from students of recognized law institutions or universities for its Winter Internship Programme, to be held from 28 December 2026 to 15 January 2027. Applications go by Registered/Speed Post to The Registrar, Odisha Human Rights Commission, Toshali Bhawan, 2nd Floor, Satyanagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha- 751007, and the last date for receipt is 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: OHRC Internship Programme at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of seats, the age limit, the stipend or the application fee.

rows.details: Winter Internship Programme (session 28 December 2026 to 15 January 2027)
Student of a recognized law institution or university; has passed the 1st year examination in a law course (5yrs Int./3 yrs.LLB), as stated in the Annexure-II undertaking
11 December 2026 (last date for receipt of the application)

content_sections.heading: About OHRC
content_sections.text: The Odisha Human Rights Commission is based at 2nd Floor, Toshali Bhawan, Satyanagar, Bhubaneswar. According to the notice, it has been regularly conducting Internship Programmes to spread awareness among university students about the protection and promotion of human rights. Interns are exposed to the functioning of the Commission's various divisions and are made aware of how complaints are attended to and what other issues the Commission takes up.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application through Registered/Speed Post addressed to: The Registrar, Odisha Human Rights Commission, Toshali Bhawan, 2nd Floor, Satyanagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha- 751007. Write the words 'FOR INTERNSHIP' in block letters on the envelope. The Bio-data must be in the format of Annexure-I (with a passport size photo) and the Undertaking in the format of Annexure-II; both formats are printed in the notice. The notice sets the deadline as the last date for receipt, so the application must reach the Commission by 11 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice announces one programme, the Winter Internship Programme, and does not give a number of seats. Applicants must be eligible students from recognized law institutions or universities. The Annexure-II undertaking states that the applicant has passed the 1st year examination in a law course (5yrs Int./3 yrs.LLB). Eligibility and selection criteria are as per the "Scheme of Internship" of the Commission, which can be downloaded from the official website ( https://ohrc.nic.in ). Pay or stipend: not specified in the notice. Candidates should read the Scheme of Internship on the official website for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-data as per format (Annexure-I), with passport size photo and signature Copy of Identity Card (Institute/University) Copy of mark sheet of last examination Proof of DOB Recommendation Letter from the Institution/University Undertaking as per format (Annexure-II) Applications without any of these will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligibility and selection criteria are as per the Scheme of Internship of the Commission. The final list of selected candidates will be displayed on the OHRC website.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Under the Annexure-II undertaking, the intern will not involve in any activity other than the assigned ones and will not show behaviour unbecoming of a law student. The intern will undergo the internship in the time specified by the Commission, 10.30 AM to 5.00 PM, and shall not leave before 5 PM during the Internship Programme. For details, contact Mr. Sushant Ku Sahoo, Sr. Programmer, at 7656849603, between 10.30 AM and 5.30 PM on all working days.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OHRC Winter Internship?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the application is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. When will the OHRC internship be held?
faq.answer: The Winter Internship Programme runs from 28 December 2026 to 15 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the OHRC internship?
faq.answer: Eligible students from recognized law institutions or universities can apply. The Annexure-II undertaking states that the applicant has passed the 1st year examination in a law course (5yrs Int./3 yrs.LLB).

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the OHRC internship?
faq.answer: Send the application by Registered/Speed Post to The Registrar, Odisha Human Rights Commission, Toshali Bhawan, 2nd Floor, Satyanagar, Bhubaneswar, Odisha- 751007, with 'FOR INTERNSHIP' written in block letters on the envelope.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Send the Bio-data (Annexure-I), copy of Identity Card, copy of last mark sheet, proof of DOB, recommendation letter from the Institution/University and the Undertaking (Annexure-II). Applications without them will be rejected.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the eligibility and selection criteria?
faq.answer: They are in the Scheme of Internship of the Commission, which can be downloaded from the official website https://ohrc.nic.in.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the list of selected candidates be shown?
faq.answer: The final list of selected candidates will be displayed on the OHRC website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the daily internship timings?
faq.answer: The undertaking states the time as 10.30 AM to 5.00 PM, and interns shall not leave before 5 PM during the programme.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact for details?
faq.answer: Contact Mr. Sushant Ku Sahoo, Sr. Programmer, at 7656849603 between 10.30 AM and 5.30 PM on all working days.
